description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Pump Gasket & Seal Kit for the Suzuki 1.3L/8V G13BA Engine.
It includes the front Crank Shaft Oil Seal and the Dip Stick Guide O-Ring
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Front Crank Shaft Oil Seal
Qty 1 – O-Ring, Dip Stick Guide
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995
Suzuki SJ413 1985-1995
